verdicts.note: Subject consistently self-refers as girl/woman in male-dominated job; clearly female.
Whole interview is about her current placement; assigned quote thin in isolation but code yes is unambiguous.
'only working because of the money' plus 'the money's good' supports strongly agree.
Quote frames placement as preparing her for real work; supports work-experience reason (agree).
'very good... to get a job afterwards' supports improving post-uni job chances (agree).
'every company's a little bit different... how they are generally run' supports seeing what industry is really like (agree).
'can't do my degree without doing placement... you have to have a placement' clearly compulsory.
Calling modules 'rubbish/no point' supports finding some modules irrelevant (agree); quote stresses uselessness rather than literal difficulty-understanding, so downgrade high to medium.
Item measures REASON for wanting placement (motivation to apply theory); quote describes retrospective non-application on the job, not her motivation. Mismatch - reject.
